instructions:
1. Stand beside a rack and place your left hand on it for support.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand with a neutral grip, arm hanging straight down.
3. Step your right foot back, bend the knees slightly and hinge forward with a flat back.
4. Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, driving your elbow back and close to your body.
5. Lower the dumbbell under control until the arm is fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your shoulders square to the floor and do not rotate your torso.
2. Drive the elbow back and down to load the lats, not the arm.
3. Pause briefly at the top and squeeze the shoulder blade.
4. Breathe out as you pull, breathe in as you lower.
name: Dumbbell One Arm Row (rack support)

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand with a neutral grip.
3. Rest your right forearm on your right thigh so the wrist extends past the knee.
4. Curl the dumbbell up by flexing the wrist and squeeze at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbell under control by extending the wrist.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the forearm pinned to the thigh and move only at the wrist.
2. Use a slow, controlled tempo without momentum.
3. Allow a full stretch at the bottom of each rep.
4. Breathe out as you curl up, breathe in as you lower.
name: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Neutral Wrist Curl

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell on the floor between them.
2. Hinge down and grasp the dumbbell with your right hand, back flat and core tight.
3. Drive through the floor and explosively extend the hips, knees and ankles.
4. Pull the dumbbell up close to your body and shrug as it rises.
5. Punch your hand up to catch the dumbbell overhead with a straight arm.
6. Lower under control to the floor and repeat.
tips:
1. Generate power from the hips and legs, not the arm.
2. Keep the dumbbell close to your body as it travels up.
3. Keep the back flat throughout the lift.
4. Exhale on the drive up, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch

instructions:
1. Sit on a flat bench with feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand and press the arm straight overhead.
3. Place your left hand on your hip for support.
4. Bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping the upper arm still.
5. Extend the arm back to straight and squeeze the triceps.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the elbow pointing forward and close to your head.
2. Move only at the elbow and keep the upper arm fixed.
3. Control the lowering phase for a full triceps stretch.
4. Exhale as you extend, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell One Arm Triceps Extension (on bench)

instructions:
1. Lie flat on a bench with feet firmly on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand pressed straight above the shoulder, palm facing forward.
3. Lower the dumbbell out and down with the elbow wide until it drops below chest level.
4. Press the dumbbell back up over the shoulder and squeeze the chest.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the elbow flared to load the chest with the wide path.
2. Keep the wrist straight and stacked over the elbow.
3. Brace the core to stay stable against the one-sided load.
4. Lower under control for a full chest stretch.
name: Dumbbell One Arm Wide Grip Bench Press
